featured.title: Eclipse
featured.story:
In ancient times we knew that Eclipse was a deity. Most people couldn’t see her then, and now almost nobody can. We trust in science and our eyes too much these days. But one has to open their eyes to see the truth sometimes. 

(I was inspired by well.. the eclipse that happened here the day before and the character design of Selene from the game Hades by @supergiantgames . This was almost meant to be a second “form” for Selene is how this started out. This one has more sun and moon patterns and symbolism. )

featured.title: Pokopia
featured.story:
I reaaaalllly want to play this game but 500 for a console and then 70 for a game? Jesus Christ why! I already have a steam deck. 

Anyway this was my way of coping. Pikachu wants to buy it. But charmander sees the wallet is empty. 
The bag is sad because it’s too small to hold the box. And the coffee machine is keeping everyone company. 
The person is the main character of the game - basically a ditto (like the one on the box) 
And I own a steam deck so that’s there below. With pokemon leaf green, a super old one

images.title: City Dragons
images.story:
So imagine a city where there are dragons but they are just a normal race like humans. They aren’t always “used” but they can find jobs if they want. For example, they can deliver post. But they can also be homeless, or grand and majestic. 

(P.S. I was trying out blender for the first time for the past few artworks. And looks like I didn’t actually do the buildings properly and they don’t scale well. I’m a bit tired of this piece but lessons for future me.)

images.title: Essence Eater
images.story:
Essence eater 
An eldritch being born from the collision of two black holes. Its insides are a sort of jagged space that consumes all just like its parents. It doesn’t really have any particular form or color but us non eldritch beings see them as something akin to an all consuming shapeless being with octopus like tentacles. 
It shrinks dramatically after birth to around the size of a normal human. 
Those who study these things have always wondered why. Perhaps it has a limit to the amount of matter it can hold? Who knows.
